name: Skyshroud
description: A forest under attack by Gathans, transplanted onto Keld, with a rift over it.

description_citations.text: "Time Spiral (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri and Hanna search the Skyshroud for Gerrard; Hanna saves Mirri from a shapeshifter and they come to an understanding.
timeline.quote: Hanna saved Mirri from, earning her Mirri's respect

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves capture Mirri and Hanna, but Gerrard is proclaimed the Korvecdal, leading to an alliance with Eladamri's rebels.
timeline.quote: leading to an alliance between the crew and the rebels

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri's wife dies in a fire that destroyed their home, likely perpetrated by Stronghold agents.
timeline.quote: His wife died in a fire that destroyed their home.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Gerrard the Korvecdal, convincing Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew.
timeline.quote: The Oracle's proclamation convinced Eladamri to aid the Weatherlight crew in their rescue mission

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "Lord of Leaves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri learns that his daughter Avila was murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent who stole her body.
timeline.quote: his daughter, Avila, had been murdered in her sleep by a Phyrexian agent while he was away fighting

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri outflanks Crovax's expeditionary force, but a failed rescue lets many survive, including Crovax.
timeline.quote: This meant that more of the Expeditionary Force survived, including Crovax.

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Oracle declares Eladamri the true Korvecdal and warns that he must leave Rath.
timeline.quote: who declared him the true Korvecdal, but warned that he would have to leave Rath for another world

citation.text: "Eladamri", section "A New Nemesis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator ambushes Weatherlight and overpowers its crew.
timeline.quote: Predator caught it by surprise, boarded it, and soon overpowered its crew.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven captures Gerrard, but Vhati's attempt to assassinate Greven knocks Gerrard overboard.
timeline.quote: Vhati missed, but the impact knocked Gerrard overboard into the forest below.

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati overboard and returns to the Stronghold with the artifacts.
timeline.quote: threw the groveling officer overboard

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elves build the new forest Skyshroud after their alliance with the merfolk ends in a bloody battle.
timeline.quote: their partnership ended abruptly in a bloody battle.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crashes in the Skyshroud forest.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight, meanwhile, crashed in the Shyshroud forest.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter in the Skyshroud forest.
timeline.quote: She disarms the monster and slices it open

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri decides the elves will attack the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Eladamri decides that the time has come for the elves to attack the Stronghold

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Hanna share a long kiss

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Hanna's Tale" ( Miranda Horner )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An assassin kills Eladamri's daughter.
timeline.quote: destroyed what Eladamri loved most: his daughter.

citation.text: Murderous Betrayal (Nemesis, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.
timeline.quote: Skyshroud forest overlayed in Keld and Eladamri the Elflord made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise transports Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld and protects Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: transported Eladamri and the Steel Leaf elves to Keld

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Powerless against Yawgmoth, Freyalise returns to Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: Powerless against the Lord of the Wastes, Freyalise returned to Skyshroud

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise relocates Skyshroud Forest, creating its rift.
timeline.quote: Freyalise relocated it from its unnamed initial destination

citation.text: "Rift", section "Skyshroud rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise gives her life to seal the Skyshroud rift and the forest dies with her.
timeline.quote: Freyalise gave her life to seal the rift

citation.text: "Rift", section "Skyshroud rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Skyshroud arrives on the frozen wastes of Keld and Freyalise casts a spell to keep it warm.
timeline.quote: it was saved by the planeswalker Freyalise , who cast a spell to keep the forest warm.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Planeshifted to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia catches Gerrard mid-air but he wrests free and falls into the forest canopy.
timeline.quote: Gerrard was caught mid-air by Selenia

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greven throws Vhati off the Predator and Vhati is impaled by a branch.
timeline.quote: Vhati met his end as he was impaled by a branch

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Skyshroud and Tahngarth is caught by Greven before he can rescue Karn.
timeline.quote: was caught by Greven before he could rescue Karn.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanna kills a shapeshifter, then she and Mirri are captured by Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: they were soon captured by Skyshroud elves.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns with Eladamri and the Oracle, having been saved by Selenia, and plans to rescue the captives and reclaim the Legacy.
timeline.quote: revealing that he had been saved by Selenia before managing to escape.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke considers murdering the Oracle but her guards spoil the opportunity.
timeline.quote: He considered murdering her, but something kept him off long enough for her guards to spoil the opportunity.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karona withdraws magic, freezing the forest for three months until Karona is killed by the Mirari-sword and it thaws.
timeline.quote: The forest thawed, and warmth returned.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Temporary loss of magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edahlis warns that slivers have taken Yavimaya and urges leaving for Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: Yavimaya is lost. We must leave now for Skyshroud.

citation.text: Firewake Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise refuses to listen to Teferi about the time rifts.
timeline.quote: She refused to listen to Teferi about the threat of the time rifts.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Time Spiral". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise takes control of the local slivers, a title usurped by the Weaver King.
timeline.quote: Freyalise took control of the local slivers, who were obedient to the strongest leader.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Time Spiral". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise sacrifices herself and Skyshroud to seal the time rift.
timeline.quote: Freyalise sacrificed herself and Skyshroud to seal the rift.

citation.text: "Freyalise", section "Time Spiral". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise's sacrifice and the Skyshroud's destruction heal Keld's rift.
timeline.quote: With the sacrifice of the planeswalker Freyalise and the destruction of the Skyshroud forest, Keld's rift was finally healed allowing the nation to start the long road back to recovery and prosperity.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The slivers overrun the forest and a time-rift links Keld to its alternate older version, and Gathan warriors attack.
timeline.quote: Soon, these time-displaced warriors attacked the true Keldons and Skyshroud's inhabitants.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Time Spiral crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise sacrifices herself to close the rift and the inhabitants must leave the weakened forest.
timeline.quote: After Freyalise sacrificed herself to close the rift

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Time Spiral crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise places the Skyshroud Forest by brute force, causing the Skyshroud rift to drain green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld.
timeline.quote: causing the Skyshroud rift to drain the green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld

citation.text: "Time Spiral", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Shiv's return imminent, Teferi and Jhoira return to Dominaria seeking information and aid, finding it nearly devoid of mana.
timeline.quote: Teferi first stops in Skyshroud but is horrified to learn that Dominaria is almost completely devoid of mana

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise refuses to help Teferi, angry over his abandonment of Dominaria during the Invasion.
timeline.quote: Freyalise refuses to help his efforts.

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi meets Radha at the rift; she agrees to join him in exchange for ancient Keldon knowledge.
timeline.quote: Radha agrees to join Teferi

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Skyshroud Freyalise uses the slivers' hive mind to beat back the Phyrexians and asks Jhoira to find Radha.
timeline.quote: She requests that Jhoira find Radha in the Pardic mountains

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weaver King follows Jodah and Venser to Skyshroud and takes control of the slivers and Phyrexians; Freyalise channels all her mana into the rift, closing it and consuming herself.
timeline.quote: closing it but completely consuming herself in the process.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise gives her spark and her life to close a temporal rift that let Phyrexian horrors cross into the present.
timeline.quote: Freyalise is gone, having given her planeswalker's spark and her life to close that rift

citation.text: "Future Sight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard plunges from the deck of the Weatherlight, with Selenia attempting to aid him, as depicted in the art of Broken Fall.
timeline.quote: Gerrard's plunge from the deck of the Weatherlight , the attempted aid of Selenia, and the broken branches of Skyshroud Forest

citation.text: "Planeswalkers' Signature Spells". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: When the Rathi Overlay begins, Freyalise plants the Skyshroud Forest in Keld; Astor meets Eladamri and takes him in, uniting Keldons and Skyshroud elves.
timeline.quote: Astor accepted the elf and began to teach him the ways of Keld

citation.text: "Astor", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion Astor has a child with a Skyshroud elf, whom he supports from afar.
timeline.quote: Astor became involved with a female Skyshroud elf

citation.text: "Astor", section "Astor's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The alliance ends in a bloody battle as food dwindles; the elves magically grow Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: their partnership ended abruptly in a bloody battle

citation.text: "Rootwater", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
